where: Monterey beach, high tide, sea water with breaking waves
summary: Worked quite well: floated and hardly rolled at all; no capsize or flip in the waves.
notes: The owner calls it the large catamaran; it is this folder's three-hull sealed outrigger (yellow PLA in the photos).
First dynamic result: waves, surf and wind were never modelled, only static heel.
Not reported: leaks after the session, waterline height, drift or recovery.
